title: ScenePanel: duplicate scene button
description:
## Problem

The ScenePanel has add (+) and delete (trash) buttons for scenes, but no Duplicate button. Flash 8's Scene panel has all three buttons. The core mutation `duplicateScene(doc, sceneId)` already exists in packages/core/src/model/document-mutations.ts, is exported from @flash/core, and has unit tests in scenemgmt.test.ts. The ScenePanel UI and Shell wiring are simply not plumbed.

## Work required

1. **ScenePanel.tsx** – Add a Duplicate icon button (copy icon, same style as the existing + and trash buttons) in the button bar at the bottom. Add a new prop `onDuplicateScene?: (index: number) => void` and call it with the currently active scene index when clicked. Disable when no scene is selected.

2. **Shell.tsx** – Add a handleDuplicateScene callback that calls `pushDoc(duplicateScene(doc, scene.id))` for the scene at the given index. Pass it as `onDuplicateScene` to ScenePanel. Import duplicateScene from @flash/core (it's already exported).

## Acceptance

- With one scene, clicking Duplicate adds 'Scene 1 copy' (or similar) after the current scene.
- The duplicated scene has the same timeline, layers, and frames as the original.
- Undo reverts the duplication.
- No TypeScript errors.
